headline: Head of Operations
profile: Operations leader with 15 years' experience, most recently Head of Esports Operations at BLAST, where I led a six-person department and the operational delivery of 60+ flagship events and 300+ qualifiers in 13 countries. That meant resource planning at scale: 2,000+ freelancers booked and contracted, €12m+ in budgets, and decisions on when to hire, buy or repair equipment. I rebuilt how the department works, with clearer ownership, accountability and proper documentation, and designed and built our own tools for equipment tracking, staffing, bookings, travel and budgets, including a suite of web tools built with Claude Code to replace spreadsheet processes. I wrote the business case for a departmental OPEX budget and worked closely with finance, product and commercial teams.

jobs.title: Head of Esports Operations
bullets: Led a six-person department running tournament operations across every BLAST ecosystem, including CS2, Dota 2, Brawl Stars, Fortnite, Rocket League and Rainbow Six
Rebuilt how the department works, with clearer ownership, accountability and proper documentation
Designed and built the department's own tools for event and equipment tracking, freelancer calendars, bookings and contracting, and event budgets and deadlines
Built the Esports Ops Suite with Claude Code: web tools on Airtable for staffing, travel approvals and scheduling, replacing the department's Google Sheets
Wrote the business case for a departmental OPEX budget covering equipment renewal, software and cross-event costs
Held fortnightly meetings with the finance team to align on budgets
Brought Team Operations into the department, so all online and offline player management and support sat with one team

Arranged venues and equipment for team bootcamps
